title: Parity child group index
statement: For natural numbers $r,q$, an index $g$ with $0\le g<r^q$, and an index $j$ with $0\le j<r$, the parity child group is the index corresponding to the pair $(g,j)$ under the bijection between such pairs and indices less than $r^{q+1}$.
